sources.finding: Blob 2219be9b4edf5d6f16b64aff948bffbb82860ede retains the complete paired inactive, reserve, participation, DNP, QB, specialist, injury, value and unresolved-case inventories. This additive correction changes only the Newsome outside-role and Adebo relief question.
The club explicitly identifies Deonte Banks and Greg Newsome II as the starting outside cornerbacks.
The Week 7 preview classifies Banks with the outside cornerbacks and Dru Phillips with the slot cornerbacks.
The club states Adebo's return came after Newsome suffered the concussion and distinguishes the prior Newsome/Banks starting alignment.
The official inactive notice pairs Newsome's concussion absence with Adebo's return from injured reserve.

PDF page 1 lists Newsome inactive and Adebo/Banks as the two starting cornerbacks. Page 20 records Adebo and Banks for all 61 defensive snaps, Phillips for 39 defensive snaps and Nic Jones for special teams only. Participation corroborates, but does not alone establish, the role assignment.
NFL.com directly states the Giants needed Adebo while Newsome was sidelined and that Adebo would return to the bench once Newsome cleared.
